status_semantics.reviewed_operational: adapter, operation, contract and handler are present; live certification is still required
status_semantics.discovered_read_only: generic discovery/capability metadata only; not an operational certification
status_semantics.blocked: business module is installed but reviewed operational coverage is incomplete

production_requires: run the live matrix and business certification on the target database; every installed business module must be reviewed_operational and all live/security gates must pass
runtime_evidence_required: GPU, queue, PostgreSQL and Redis observations from the same run
